workflow_name: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr
workflow_description: Flag line items where Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than Posting Date, including across years, indicating potential timing irregularities.
business_logic_plan:
Complete Business Logic Plan: Expenses document date later than posting date

Objective
- Flag all G/L line items where the Document Date falls in a later calendar month-year than the Posting Date (any difference of 1+ months, including across years).
- No exclusions; include all rows.

Data Source
- Input CSV: data/uploads/7bf59a48-301c-48eb-be86-dba030aed464/FBL3N.csv

Columns Used
- Core comparison: Document Date, Posting Date
- Identification: Company Code, Document Number, G/L Account
- Context: Amount in local currency, Amount in doc. curr., Local Currency, Document currency, Document Type, Text, Document Header Text, Cost Center, Profit Center, Reference, Assignment, User Name, Entry Date
- Derived: Document_Month_Year, Posting_Month_Year, Month_Difference

Scope and Inclusion Rules
- Include all G/L line items; do not restrict by account ranges, document types, amount, or cost center.
- Treat each row as a separate line item, even if multiple lines share the same Document Number.

Core Exception Rule
- Compute calendar month and year from Document Date and Posting Date.
- Flag when Document Date’s month-year is later than Posting Date’s month-year.
- Month_Difference = (DocumentYear − PostingYear) × 12 + (DocumentMonth − PostingMonth)
- Include a row if Month_Difference >= 1.

Detailed Steps
1) Load data
- Load FBL3N.csv.

2) Derive calendar components and labels
- From Document Date derive:
  - DocumentYear (calendar year)
  - DocumentMonth (1–12, calendar month)
  - Document_Month_Year as YYYY-MM
- From Posting Date derive:
  - PostingYear (calendar year)
  - PostingMonth (1–12, calendar month)
  - Posting_Month_Year as YYYY-MM

3) Compute month difference
- Month_Difference = (DocumentYear − PostingYear) × 12 + (DocumentMonth − PostingMonth)

4) Apply exception filter
- Keep rows where Month_Difference >= 1.
- Do not exclude zero-amounts, reversals, or any document types.

5) Select output columns (in this order)
- Identification:
  - Company Code
  - Document Number
  - G/L Account
- Business Logic Columns:
  - Document Date
  - Posting Date
- Context:
  - Amount in local currency
  - Amount in doc. curr.
  - Local Currency
  - Document currency
  - Document Type
  - Text
  - Document Header Text
  - Cost Center
  - Profit Center
  - Reference
  - Assignment
  - User Name
  - Entry Date
- Calculated:
  - Document_Month_Year
  - Posting_Month_Year
  - Month_Difference

6) Optional ordering for review (non-critical)
- Sort by Month_Difference descending, then by Posting Date ascending, then Document Number ascending.

7) Output
- Produce a single CSV file containing only the filtered exceptions with the selected columns.

Business Rules Clarifications and Edge Cases
- Cross-year cases are included (e.g., Posting Date 2023-12, Document Date 2024-01 will be flagged; Month_Difference = 1).
- Same month-year is not flagged (Month_Difference = 0).
- Cases where Document Date is earlier than Posting Date are not included (Month_Difference < 0).
- No special handling for quarter-end or year-end; all differences of 1+ months are flagged.
- The Year/month column in the input is not used for comparison since we are using calendar months derived directly from Document Date and Posting Date.

Example Implementation Logic (pseudocode)
- Load FBL3N
- For each row:
  - Extract DocumentYear, DocumentMonth from Document Date
  - Extract PostingYear, PostingMonth from Posting Date
  - Document_Month_Year = format(DocumentYear, DocumentMonth) as YYYY-MM
  - Posting_Month_Year = format(PostingYear, PostingMonth) as YYYY-MM
  - Month_Difference = (DocumentYear − PostingYear) × 12 + (DocumentMonth − PostingMonth)
- Filter rows where Month_Difference >= 1
- Select and order columns as listed above
- Export to CSV

Acceptance Criteria
- Every row in the output represents one G/L line item where Document Date month-year is later than Posting Date month-year by at least one month.
- Calculated fields are present and correctly reflect the comparison and difference.
- No rows are excluded beyond the date rule; all document types and amounts are considered.

This plan is ready to implement to generate the single exceptions CSV.
